shelters.name: Sioux Falls Area Humane Society
shelters.description: Serving since 1919, largest animal shelter in eastern South Dakota. Open admission providing safe haven for 8,000+ animals annually. Provides animal control for Sioux Falls and 5 surrounding counties.

shelters.name: Humane Society of the Black Hills
shelters.description: Western South Dakota resource for animal adoptions, surrender, reclaim, and licensing. Open admission shelter managing about 4,000 animals annually.

shelters.name: Battle Mountain Humane Society
shelters.description: No-kill shelter in the Black Hills area. Rescues abused, homeless, or abandoned dogs and cats. Saves lives of over 500 pets annually.

shelters.name: Siouxland Humane Society
shelters.description: Siouxland's only open admission full service shelter. Caring for thousands of pets annually. Finds forever homes for 100% of adoptable pets.

shelters.name: Heartland Humane Society
shelters.description: Limited-admissions animal shelter committed to providing compassionate care and responsible placement for pets in need.

shelters.name: Almost Home Canine Rescue
shelters.description: Dedicated to rescuing homeless animals in South Dakota. Team passionate about cat and dog rescue in Sioux Falls.

shelters.name: Sioux Falls Canine Rescue
shelters.description: Canine rescue organization helping pets and owners in the Sioux Falls area.

shelters.name: Aberdeen Area Humane Society
shelters.description: Shelters, treats, and adopts out animals. Organizes community programs and operates as animal protection and welfare group.

shelters.name: Brookings Regional Humane Society
shelters.description: Shelters, protects, and fosters adoptions for dogs, cats, and small companion animals.

shelters.name: Dakota Dachshund Rescue
shelters.description: Committed to rescuing Dachshunds and placing them in forever homes. Provides humane end-of-life care for rescued canines.

shelters.name: Pierre Area Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving the state capital area and central South Dakota.

shelters.name: Watertown Area Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Watertown and northeastern South Dakota.

shelters.name: Yankton County Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Yankton County and southeastern South Dakota.

shelters.name: Pennington County Sheriff's Office Animal Control
shelters.description: County animal control serving Pennington County in the Black Hills area.

shelters.name: Warhorse Liberation
shelters.description: Saves horses from slaughter and provides free equine-assisted therapy to veterans.

notes: Comprehensive collection of South Dakota animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Sioux Falls Area Humane Society (since 1919) serves 8,000+ animals annually. Humane Society of the Black Hills manages 4,000 animals annually. Coverage spans Sioux Falls, Rapid City, Aberdeen, Brookings, Pierre, and Black Hills region.
